title_original: ‘The Further Mis-Adventures Of Cliff Booth’: New Photos Of Film Starring Brad Pitt, Elizabeth Debicki, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II & More
excerpt_original: Netflix has released a new set of images for The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, the David Fincher film starring Brad Pitt and written by Quentin Tarantino. Pitt reprises his role as Cliff Booth in the film, set for release November 25 in Imax and December 23 on Netflix.…

blocks.text: Netflix has released a new set of images for The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth , the David Fincher film starring Brad Pitt and written by Quentin Tarantino.

links.text: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth

blocks.text: Pitt reprises his role as Cliff Booth in the film, set for release November 25 in Imax and December 23 on Netflix.
The film also stars Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Peter Weller, Matt Groove, JB Tadena, Corey Fogelmanis, Karren Karagulian.

links.text: David Fincher Scrapped 60 Pages Of Tarantino’s ‘Cliff Booth’ Script: “It Was Essentially Two Movies”

blocks.text: Murder, blackmail, theft, extortion — just another summer in Hollywood. It’s 1977, eight years since Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt) encountered the Manson family in Tarantino’s parallel history of 1969, Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood .

The fairy tale is now over in The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth . Los Angeles no longer needs a hippie-slaying stuntman the way it did. But Hollywood will always have problems, problems that can only be solved by someone with Cliff’s unique (occasionally extralegal) abilities. When he’s not earning his keep bartending or as a projectionist, Cliff Booth is a fixer — solving situations for Hollywood’s great and, sometimes, not so good.

blocks.text: He’s curious when he gets a call from talent agent Karen Crosby (Debicki), on behalf of her client, TV megastar Charlie Peters (Scott Caan) — a man known for doing his own stunts. And he’s further entertained and intrigued when he meets other characters in Charlie’s world, from his knowing wife Toni (Gugino) to pro football champion turned screen star Roderick “Hot Rod” Harrison (Abdul-Mateen II). Then there are the Verdusco brothers (Groove and Tadena), mysterious gangsters causing mayhem across the city. What was once a fairytale is now a crime story — a cocktail of violence, ambition, and desire that could only happen in LA.
